current_role: Founder and president of Emerson Collective; chair and majority owner of The Atlantic
summary: Laurene Powell Jobs, the widow of Apple co-founder Steve Jobs, runs Emerson Collective, an investment and philanthropy firm, and owns The Atlantic. One of the largest Democratic donors, she has been a close friend and backer of Kamala Harris for about two decades, and gave $2 million to back Hillary Clinton in 2016.

connections.description: Friends for about two decades: Powell Jobs gave to Harris's first district attorney race in 2003, hosted fundraisers for her in 2009 and reportedly 2013, brought her to the 2012 State of the Union, and gave millions to groups backing her 2024 campaign; Harris reportedly sought her advice as Biden faced pressure to withdraw.

connections.name: Kamala Harris
connections.description: Powell Jobs has funded Harris since 2003, including nearly $1 million to the Biden–Harris re-election effort in 2023 and millions more to groups backing Harris in 2024. FEC filings show $10,400 from Laurene Powell Jobs to Kamala Harris for Senate, Fearless for the People PAC in 2 cycles (2016–2018).
